title: Sum two entered numbers
description: Write a script that asks the user for two whole numbers, one at a time, with the exact prompts `"Enter first number: "` and `"Enter second number: "`, then prints their sum in the exact form `"Sum: <total>"`.
examples:
Enter first number: 3
Enter second number: 4
Sum: 7
hints: You need two separate values from the user, so you'll call the input function twice.
input() always returns a string, so you need int() to convert each entry into a whole number before adding them.
Call `int(input('Enter first number: '))` and `int(input('Enter second number: '))`, add the results, and print `f'Sum: {total}'`.
expected_behavior: Prompts for two numbers in order and prints their sum after the label 'Sum: '.

hidden_tests.expected_stdout: Enter first number: Enter second number: Sum: 7
hidden_tests.label: 3 plus 4

hidden_tests.expected_stdout: Enter first number: Enter second number: Sum: 8
hidden_tests.label: 10 plus -2

explanation: Two calls to input() each display their prompt and read one line. Wrapping each in int() converts the text into a whole number so `+` performs numeric addition instead of string concatenation, and the result is printed with the required label.
